src/FAST_LIO/README.md:7:3. [LI_Init](https://github.com/hku-mars/LiDAR_IMU_Init): A robust, real-time LiDAR-IMU extrinsic initialization and synchronization package..
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:44:3. Since no requirements for feature extraction, FAST-LIO2 can support many types of LiDAR including spinning (Velodyne, Ouster) and solid-state (Livox Avia, Horizon, MID-70) LiDARs, and can be easily extended to support more LiDARs.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:76:### 1.3. **livox_ros_driver**
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:77:Follow [livox_ros_driver Installation](https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver).
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:80:- Since the FAST-LIO must support Livox serials LiDAR firstly, so the **livox_ros_driver** must be installed and **sourced** before run any FAST-LIO luanch file.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:81:- How to source? The easiest way is add the line ``` source $Livox_ros_driver_dir$/devel/setup.bash ``` to the end of file ``` ~/.bashrc ```, where ``` $Livox_ros_driver_dir$ ``` is the directory of the livox ros driver workspace (should be the ``` ws_livox ``` directory if you completely followed the livox official document).
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:148:- Remember to source the livox_ros_driver before build (follow 1.3 **livox_ros_driver**)
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:158:C. We recommend to set the **extrinsic_est_en** to false if the extrinsic is give. As for the extrinsic initiallization, please refer to our recent work: [**Robust Real-time LiDAR-inertial Initialization**](https://github.com/hku-mars/LiDAR_IMU_Init).
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:160:### 3.1 For Avia
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:161:Connect to your PC to Livox Avia LiDAR by following  [Livox-ros-driver installation](https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver), then
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:165:    roslaunch fast_lio mapping_avia.launch
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:166:    roslaunch livox_ros_driver livox_lidar_msg.launch
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:168:- For livox serials, FAST-LIO only support the data collected by the ``` livox_lidar_msg.launch ``` since only its ``` livox_ros_driver/CustomMsg ``` data structure produces the timestamp of each LiDAR point which is very important for the motion undistortion. ``` livox_lidar.launch ``` can not produce it right now.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:169:- If you want to change the frame rate, please modify the **publish_freq** parameter in the [livox_lidar_msg.launch](https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver/blob/master/livox_ros_driver/launch/livox_lidar_msg.launch) of [Livox-ros-driver](https://github.com/Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver) before make the livox_ros_driver pakage.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:171:### 3.2 For Livox serials with external IMU
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:173:mapping_avia.launch theratically supports mid-70, mid-40 or other livox serial LiDAR, but need to setup some parameters befor run:
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:175:Edit ``` config/avia.yaml ``` to set the below parameters:
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:177:1. LiDAR point cloud topic name: ``` lid_topic ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:178:2. IMU topic name: ``` imu_topic ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:179:3. Translational extrinsic: ``` extrinsic_T ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:180:4. Rotational extrinsic: ``` extrinsic_R ``` (only support rotation matrix)
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:181:- The extrinsic parameters in FAST-LIO is defined as the LiDAR's pose (position and rotation matrix) in IMU body frame (i.e. the IMU is the base frame). They can be found in the official manual.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:182:- FAST-LIO produces a very simple software time sync for livox LiDAR, set parameter ```time_sync_en``` to ture to turn on. But turn on **ONLY IF external time synchronization is really not possible**, since the software time sync cannot make sure accuracy.
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:190:1. LiDAR point cloud topic name: ``` lid_topic ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:191:2. IMU topic name: ``` imu_topic ``` (both internal and external, 6-aixes or 9-axies are fine)
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:192:3. Set the parameter ```timestamp_unit``` based on the unit of **time** (Velodyne) or **t** (Ouster) field in PoindCloud2 rostopic
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:193:4. Line number (we tested 16, 32 and 64 line, but not tested 128 or above): ``` scan_line ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:194:5. Translational extrinsic: ``` extrinsic_T ```
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:195:6. Rotational extrinsic: ``` extrinsic_R ``` (only support rotation matrix)
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:196:- The extrinsic parameters in FAST-LIO is defined as the LiDAR's pose (position and rotation matrix) in IMU body frame (i.e. the IMU is the base frame).
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:213:roslaunch test_interface single_drone_avia.launch
src/FAST_LIO/README.md:224:Set ``` pcd_save_enable ``` in launchfile to ``` 1 ```. All the scans (in global frame) will be accumulated and saved to the file ``` FAST_LIO/PCD/scans.pcd ``` after the FAST-LIO is terminated. ```pcl_viewer scans.pcd``` can visualize the point clouds.
